🔗 Official links (sirf yahin se download karo) 1) Image Toolbox — https://github.com/T8RIN/ImageToolbox Releases: https://github.com/T8RIN/ImageToolbox/releases · F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/packages/ru.tech.imageresizershrinker/ · Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ru.tech.imageresizershrinker 2) ColorBlendr — https://github.com/Mahmud0808/ColorBlendr F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/en/packages/com.drdisagree.colorblendr/ · IzzyOnDroid: https://apt.izzysoft.de/packages/com.drdisagree.colorblendr/ · Android 12+ aur Root/Shizuku/Wireless ADB chahiye Shizuku: https://shizuku.rikka.app/guide/setup/ 3) URLCheck — https://github.com/TrianguloY/URLCheck F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.trianguloy.urlchecker/ · Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trianguloy.urlchecker 4) HTTP Shortcuts — https://github.com/Waboodoo/HTTP-Shortcuts Docs: https://http-shortcuts.rmy.ch/ · F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/en/packages/ch.rmy.android.http_shortcuts/ · Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.rmy.android.http_shortcuts 5) OpenScan — https://github.com/ethereal-developers/OpenScan Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ethereal.openscan · IzzyOnDroid: https://apt.izzysoft.de/packages/com.ethereal.openscan/ Updates ke liye: Obtainium — https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium
